suppress.notes: CVE-2022-31691 is in the Spring Tools IDE plugins (Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse up to 4.16.0, the VS Code extensions up to 1.39.0): their YAML editor runs SnakeYAML on untrusted files. It matches spring-boot-devtools only through the shared vmware:spring_boot / spring_tools CPE names; DevTools has no such code, and is also left out of the production jar (optional, excluded on repackage). Look again if a CVE ever names spring-boot-devtools itself.
